zh-CN.headlineFact: 关税、AI、选举与天空进入倒计时
zh-CN.headlineView: 全球系统同时测试执行力与准备度
zh-CN.headlineFull: 关税、AI、选举与天空进入倒计时；全球系统同时测试执行力与准备度
zh-CN.intro: 北美贸易成本、AI公司换帅、单人创业方法、原住民照护、欧洲田径、日全食与赞比亚大选都进入明确行动窗口。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 倒计时真正衡量的，是组织能否把信息变成准备。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 九条时间线，今天都开始走得更快。

en-US.headlineFact: Tariffs, AI, elections and the sky enter countdowns
en-US.headlineView: global systems test execution and readiness together
en-US.headlineFull: Tariffs, AI, elections and the sky enter countdowns; global systems test execution and readiness together
en-US.intro: North American trade costs, AI leadership, solo-business methods, Indigenous care, European athletics, a total eclipse and Zambia's election enter clear action windows.
en-US.xiaziQuote: A countdown really measures whether organizations turn information into readiness.
en-US.doudouQuote: Nine timelines all start moving faster today.

sources.title: Imposing Additional Duties To Offset Canadian Discrimination Against the Commerce of the United States With Respect to Dairy
The Government launches the official website with information on the three eclipse events

zh-CN.headlineFact: 美国对部分加拿大乳品加征50%关税
zh-CN.headlineView: 8月19日前重算价格与清关路径
zh-CN.headlineFull: 美国对部分加拿大乳品加征50%关税；8月19日前重算价格与清关路径
zh-CN.intro: 新关税将于8月19日生效；相关品牌、平台卖家与进口商需核对商品清单、原产地、库存周转和到岸成本。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 关税落地前九天，最贵的不是调整，而是没有商品级测算。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 先把每个SKU的税和库存摊开看。

en-US.headlineFact: US adds 50% duty on selected Canadian dairy goods
en-US.headlineView: reprice and reroute customs before August 19
en-US.headlineFull: US adds 50% duty on selected Canadian dairy goods; reprice and reroute customs before August 19
en-US.intro: The new duty takes effect August 19; brands, marketplace sellers and importers should check product lists, origin, inventory turns and landed cost.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Nine days before a tariff lands, the costliest mistake is having no SKU-level model.
en-US.doudouQuote: Lay out tax and inventory for every SKU first.

sources.title: Imposing Additional Duties To Offset Canadian Discrimination Against the Commerce of the United States With Respect to Dairy

zh-CN.headlineView: 数据基础设施进入增长与治理新阶段
zh-CN.headlineFull: Scale AI新任CEO今日履职；数据基础设施进入增长与治理新阶段
zh-CN.intro: Francis deSouza于8月10日正式出任CEO；行业关注公司在模型数据、企业客户、人才和治理上的下一步。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: AI基础设施的竞争，正在从速度扩展到信任、交付与组织能力。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 换帅只是起点，客户要看下一张交付表。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：人工智能 AI。

en-US.headlineFact: Scale AI's new CEO starts today
en-US.headlineView: data infrastructure enters a new growth and governance phase
en-US.headlineFull: Scale AI's new CEO starts today; data infrastructure enters a new growth and governance phase
en-US.intro: Francis deSouza becomes CEO on August 10, focusing attention on the company's next moves in model data, enterprise customers, talent and governance.
en-US.xiaziQuote: AI infrastructure competition is expanding from speed to trust, delivery and organizational capability.
en-US.doudouQuote: A new leader is the start; customers will watch the next delivery sheet.

sources.title: Scale AI Appoints Francis deSouza as CEO to Lead Next Phase of Company's Growth

zh-CN.headlineFact: SBA课程拆解六位数一人公司
zh-CN.headlineView: 增长重点从工具转向定位与获客
zh-CN.headlineFull: SBA课程拆解六位数一人公司；增长重点从工具转向定位与获客
zh-CN.intro: 8月10日线上活动聚焦成功单人创业的前五步、客户获取、收入模型与可复制流程，适合把AI效率落到经营系统。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 一人公司的杠杆，不是做更多，而是让正确动作可以重复。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 工具装满桌，不如先写清第一位客户。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：一人公司 OPC。

en-US.headlineFact: SBA session breaks down a six-figure solo business
en-US.headlineView: growth shifts from tools to positioning and acquisition
en-US.headlineFull: SBA session breaks down a six-figure solo business; growth shifts from tools to positioning and acquisition
en-US.intro: The August 10 online event covers the first five steps, customer acquisition, revenue models and repeatable systems for solo entrepreneurs using AI leverage.
en-US.xiaziQuote: A solo company's leverage is not doing more; it is making the right actions repeatable.
en-US.doudouQuote: A desk full of tools matters less than defining the first customer.

sources.title: One-Person Empire: How to Build a Six-Figure Business in 2026

zh-CN.headlineFact: 联合国今日举行原住民助产士纪念活动
zh-CN.headlineView: 照护知识进入政策与资源讨论
zh-CN.headlineFull: 联合国今日举行原住民助产士纪念活动；照护知识进入政策与资源讨论
zh-CN.intro: 纽约时间8月10日举行线上活动，讨论原住民助产士的认可、文化适宜照护以及保护社区知识体系的政策路径。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 认可知识不能只停在致敬，还要进入制度、预算和服务。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 让守护生命的人，也被系统好好守护。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：原住民健康。

en-US.headlineFact: UN holds Indigenous midwives event today
en-US.headlineView: care knowledge moves into policy and resource debate
en-US.headlineFull: UN holds Indigenous midwives event today; care knowledge moves into policy and resource debate
en-US.intro: The August 10 online event discusses recognition of Indigenous midwives, culturally appropriate care and policy pathways that protect community knowledge systems.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Recognizing knowledge must move beyond tribute into institutions, budgets and services.
en-US.doudouQuote: Systems should also protect those who protect life.

sources.title: International Day of the World's Indigenous Peoples

zh-CN.headlineFact: 欧洲田径锦标赛今日在伯明翰开幕
zh-CN.headlineView: 七天赛程考验竞技与城市运营
zh-CN.headlineFull: 欧洲田径锦标赛今日在伯明翰开幕；七天赛程考验竞技与城市运营
zh-CN.intro: 赛事于8月10日至16日在亚历山大体育场举行，涵盖田赛、径赛、路跑、竞走和全能项目。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 大型赛事不只看奖牌，也看交通、转播和观众体验如何协同。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 枪声响前，整座城市已经在接力。

en-US.headlineFact: European Athletics Championships open in Birmingham
en-US.headlineView: seven days test sport and city operations
en-US.headlineFull: European Athletics Championships open in Birmingham; seven days test sport and city operations
en-US.intro: The August 10-16 championships at Alexander Stadium cover track, field, road running, race walking and combined events.
en-US.xiaziQuote: A major event measures more than medals; transport, broadcast and spectator experience must work together.
en-US.doudouQuote: Before the starter's gun, the whole city is already in a relay.

zh-CN.headlineFact: 8月12日日全食进入两天倒计时
zh-CN.headlineView: 观测安全与交通准备成为焦点
zh-CN.headlineFull: 8月12日日全食进入两天倒计时；观测安全与交通准备成为焦点
zh-CN.intro: 全食带将经过格陵兰、冰岛、俄罗斯北部、西班牙和葡萄牙一角；欧洲、非洲及北美部分地区可见偏食。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 稀有天象越壮观，越需要把滤镜、路线和天气预案做具体。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 抬头之前，先把安全观测镜戴好。

en-US.headlineFact: August 12 total solar eclipse enters two-day countdown
en-US.headlineView: viewing safety and travel preparation take focus
en-US.headlineFull: August 12 total solar eclipse enters two-day countdown; viewing safety and travel preparation take focus
en-US.intro: Totality crosses Greenland, Iceland, northern Russia, Spain and a corner of Portugal; a partial eclipse is visible across wider regions.
en-US.xiaziQuote: The rarer the spectacle, the more concrete filters, routes and weather plans must become.
en-US.doudouQuote: Before looking up, put on safe eclipse glasses.

sources.title: The Government launches the official website with information on the three eclipse events

zh-CN.headlineFact: 赞比亚大选进入最后三天
zh-CN.headlineView: 投票准备与和平交接受关注
zh-CN.headlineFull: 赞比亚大选进入最后三天；投票准备与和平交接受关注
zh-CN.intro: 8月13日6时至18时举行投票，选出总统、议员和地方代表；选民教育、投票站准备与结果流程进入最后阶段。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 选举的可信度，来自每个具体环节都能被理解和验证。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 选票很小，背后的流程必须足够清楚。

en-US.headlineFact: Zambia election enters its final three days
en-US.headlineView: poll readiness and peaceful transition draw attention
en-US.headlineFull: Zambia election enters its final three days; poll readiness and peaceful transition draw attention
en-US.intro: Voting runs 06:00-18:00 on August 13 for president, parliament and local offices; voter education, polling stations and results procedures enter the final stage.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Election credibility comes from every concrete step being understandable and verifiable.
en-US.doudouQuote: A ballot is small; the process behind it must be clear.

zh-CN.headlineFact: 月球今日运行至近地点
zh-CN.headlineView: 为日食与流星雨周拉开观测序幕
zh-CN.headlineFull: 月球今日运行至近地点；为日食与流星雨周拉开观测序幕
zh-CN.intro: NASA天象日历显示月球于8月10日11时18分UTC到达近地点，随后是12日新月与日全食、13日英仙座流星雨。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 把单个天象放进时间序列，才能看懂天空真正的节奏。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 月亮先靠近，再把舞台交给日食和流星。

en-US.headlineFull: Moon reaches perigee today; opening an eclipse-and-meteor week
en-US.intro: NASA's sky calendar places lunar perigee at 11:18 UTC on August 10, followed by the August 12 new moon and total eclipse and the August 13 Perseids.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Place one sky event in a sequence to understand the real rhythm above us.
en-US.doudouQuote: The Moon comes closer, then hands the stage to eclipse and meteors.
